description: List all registered customers who have never had a completed order (anti-join). A customer with only cancelled or pending orders still qualifies. Guest orders have customer_id = NULL in the orders table and must not affect the result. Output columns: customer_id (INT64), email (STRING), signup_date (DATE). Sort by customer_id.

customer_id.description: Foreign key to customers; NULL for guest checkout

edge_cases: Guest orders with NULL customer_id exist in the orders table
Customer with only cancelled orders must be returned
Customer with both a cancelled and a completed order must not be returned
common_failure_modes: FM5: customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders ...) returns zero rows when the subquery contains a NULL
FM1: LEFT JOIN with the status filter in WHERE instead of ON turns the anti-join into an inner join and drops customers with only cancelled orders
